python3 -c "
import subprocess

tests = [
    ([], b''),
    ([], b'A'),
    ([], b'\xfe\xfe'),
    ([], b'\x80\x80'),
    (['bad'], b'\xfe'),
    (['bad'], b'\x80'),
    (['bad'], b'A'),
    (['good'], b'\xfe'),
    (['good'], b'\x80'),
    (['good'], b'A'),
    (['other'], b'\xfe\xfe'),
]

for args, inp in tests:
    res1 = subprocess.run(['./chal'] + args, input=inp, capture_output=True)
    res2 = subprocess.run(['./recon_bin'] + args, input=inp, capture_output=True)
    assert res1.returncode == res2.returncode, f'Return code mismatch: {res1.returncode} vs {res2.returncode}'
    assert res1.stdout == res2.stdout, f'Stdout mismatch for args={args}, inp={inp}:\nchal:\n{res1.stdout}\nrecon:\n{res2.stdout}'
    assert res1.stderr == res2.stderr, f'Stderr mismatch for args={args}, inp={inp}'
print('All test cases passed identically!')
"

python3 -c "
import subprocess

for b in range(256):
    byte_val = bytes([b])
    for mode in [[], ['bad'], ['good'], ['other']]:
        res1 = subprocess.run(['./chal'] + mode, input=byte_val*2, capture_output=True)
        res2 = subprocess.run(['./recon_bin'] + mode, input=byte_val*2, capture_output=True)
        if res1.returncode != res2.returncode or res1.stdout != res2.stdout or res1.stderr != res2.stderr:
            print(f'Mismatch on byte {b} (0x{b:02x}) with mode {mode}')
            print('chal:', res1.stdout)
            print('recon:', res2.stdout)
            exit(1)
print('All 256 byte values match identically for all modes!')
"
